acceptance_criteria: 新しい版で全必須試験が通る
scope: scripts/required_checks.py runs every run step of the release verification workflow except installs, read from the workflow itself, with the interpreter of a candidate environment. The lock-candidate workflow resolves the newest allowed versions on dependency changes and weekly, installs them by hash and runs them all: run 45945589880 passed 28 of 28 required checks on the candidate set (including the 603 testing-phase cases). The candidate lock and its dependency record are kept for review.
